metadata.title: GeoProofBench v0.1: a verified spatial-computation benchmark suite for terrain algorithms

creators.name: Guo, Yinggang
creators.affiliation: Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology, Xi'an 710024, China

metadata.description: Digital elevation model (DEM) analysis underlies terrain-related work across geomorphology, hydrology, and civil engineering, yet published algorithms are rarely machine-checked. GeoProofBench (GPB) is a proposition set of terrain-analysis claims expressed in two proof languages simultaneously — Dafny and Lean 4 — and a reproducible pipeline that compiles each proposition to a numerical witness, a Wolfram symbolic check, and a manim visualization, all keyed to a single GPB-N ENTRY: PASS verdict. This deposit contains six first-order operators, three composition records, four boundary witnesses, five noise levels, four DEM stacks, Dafny/Lean sources, Python/Wolfram drivers, and mp4 animations. Data are licensed CC-BY-4.0; software is licensed MIT. Public release is intended at journal acceptance; until then this record may be reserved/restricted.
